item.title: Copilot, Microsoft 365 & Power Platform Community Call - September 2026
EPPC26 - The Human Hack: The Future of Consulting Culture
item.description:
The Human Hack: The Future of Consulting Culture

This isn’t about tools, templates, frameworks, or even just the latest AI technologies—it’s about people and mindset.

AI is driving a significant shift in the consulting landscape, encouraging a heightened focus on tools, templates, and frameworks at the risk of losing the human experience and mindset. In this honest and practical session, we explore how consultants and delivery leads can rediscover and develop better consulting cultures in a world obsessed with tools and delivery speed.
